results.title: Ghana urged to adopt rapid cancer diagnostic technology to cut delays in treatments
results.content: Founder and President of Breast Care International (BCI) Dr. Beatrice Wiafe Addai, has urged the Government to explore adopting rapid cancer diagnostic technology capable of producing breast biopsy images within five minutes to reduce delays in diagnosis and treatment.

results.title: Joseph Kofi Assempah named CEO of the Year – Print at Ghana CEO Awards
results.content: The award recognises Mr. Assempah's leadership in Ghana's printing and visual communication industry, as well as his contribution to the growth of Assempahfie Graphics, a printing and branding company based in Kokomlemle, Accra.

results.title: Two young men arrested over murder of female tricycle rider in Bono East Region
results.content: The Ghana Police Service has arrested two young men in connection with the murder of a female tricycle rider and the theft of her vehicle at Afrancho, near Konkoli, in the Trede District of the Bono East Region.

results.title: Irene Atubiga: Woman killed in Sakumono shooting alongside her uncle identified as CEO of Kussa Shea Bliss
results.content: The 47-year-old woman shot dead alongside her uncle at NTHC Estate in Sakumono, Accra, has been identified as Irene Atubiga, an entrepreneur and Chief Executive Officer of Kussa Shea Bliss, a shea butter-based skincare and personal care products company.

results.title: NRSA urges police to arrest pedestrians who fail to use footbridges
results.content: The National Road Safety Authority (NRSA) has urged the Motor Traffic and Transport Department (MTTD) of the Ghana Police Service to arrest and prosecute pedestrians who fail to use designated footbridges, as part of efforts to reduce road crashes and fatalities.

results.title: Sarkodie mourns Ghanaian teenager shot dead in New York
results.content: Ghanaian rapper Michael Owusu Addo, popularly known as Sarkodie, has expressed sorrow over the death of a Ghanaian teenager, Javits, who was reportedly shot in the abdomen while walking near a school in the Bronx, New York.

results.title: Inusah Fuseini says NPP’s suit on presidential term limit is needless
results.content: Former Tamale Central MP, Inusah Fuseini, says the New Patriotic Party (NPP) does not need to seek a Supreme Court interpretation of the constitutional provisions governing presidential term limits, arguing that the 1992 Constitution already provides a clear restriction.

results.title: Inusah Fuseini urges Mahama to reject 3rd term bid even if Supreme Court allows it
results.content: Former Tamale Central MP, Inusah Fuseini, has called on President John Dramani Mahama to rule out any attempt to seek a third presidential term, even if the Supreme Court interprets the 1992 Constitution as allowing such a possibility.

results.title: Chelsea beat 10-man Manchester United to pile more pressure on Carrick
results.content: United are now without a win in nine games in all competitions, their longest such run since October-November 1988.

results.title: Otto Addo drags GFA to FIFA over contract termination, demands more than $750,000
results.content: Former Ghana coach Otto Addo has lodged a complaint with FIFA against the Ghana Football Association (GFA) following the termination of his contract in March, JoySports can exclusively reveal.

results.title: COCOBOD CEO woos investors with Ghana’s new cocoa financing model at New York forum
results.content: The Chief Executive Officer of the Ghana Cocoa Board (COCOBOD), Dr Ransford Anertey Abbey, has presented Ghana’s new cocoa financing model and outlined reforms aimed at strengthening the cocoa sector at the Africa Cocoa Finance & Investment Forum (ACFIF) in New York.

results.title: Zenith Bank Ghana steps up staff wellness, SME support and digital lending — MD
results.content: The Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Zenith Bank (Ghana) Limited, Henry C. Onwuzurigbo, says the bank is strengthening its focus on employee wellness, SME financing and digital banking as part of efforts to support business growth and improve customer experience.

results.title: Mahama pledges to advance Nkrumah’s Pan-Africanist vision
results.content: President John Dramani Mahama has reaffirmed his commitment to protecting Ghana’s national interest, promoting resource-driven economic development and advancing the ideals of Pan-Africanism.

results.title: ‘It’s a storm in a teacup until there’s strong evidence of wrongdoing’ – Sulemana Braimah on SA evacuation
results.content: Executive Director of the Media Foundation for West Africa (MFWA), Sulemana Braimah, has described the controversy surrounding the government’s evacuation of Ghanaians from South Africa as a “storm in a teacup”, saying that allegations of wrongdoing should not be entertained without concrete evidence.

results.title: Mahama must apologise to Akufo-Addo over honorary doctorates – Nana Akomea
results.content: The Third National Vice Chairman of the New Patriotic Party (NPP), Nana Akomea, has challenged President John Dramani Mahama to apologise to former President Nana Akufo-Addo for his past comments criticising the conferment of honorary degrees on serving presidents.

results.title: Christian Council of Ghana questions government’s conflicting stance on galamsey
results.content: The Christian Council of Ghana has questioned the government’s approach to fighting illegal mining, saying statements by some public officers appear to contradict efforts to clamp down on the practice.

results.title: Zenith Bank holds annual health walk to promote fitness and healthy living
results.content: The Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Zenith Bank (Ghana) Limited, Henry C. Onwuzurigbo, has highlighted the importance of physical fitness and employee wellness, describing the bank’s annual health walk as a key initiative for promoting healthy living and strengthening relationships with customers and stakeholders.

results.title: ECG restores Clou Smart Prepayment Metering service
results.content: The Electricity Company of Ghana (ECG) has announced the restoration of its Clou Smart Prepayment Metering System following a service disruption.

results.title: Galamsey has evolved into transnational organised crime – Prof. Appiagyei-Tua
results.content: Professor of International Law and Human Rights at the University of Ghana School of Law, Prof. Kwadwo Appiagyei-Tua, says illegal mining in Ghana has evolved into a form of transnational organised crime driven by profit, coercion, violence and corruption.

results.title: NDC officials and other party members are the ones doing galamsey – Miracles Aboagye
results.content: The National Communications Director of the opposition New Patriotic Party (NPP), Dennis Miracles Aboagye, has accused members and executives of the governing National Democratic Congress (NDC) of engaging in illegal mining, popularly known as galamsey.

results.title: NDC has always been an enabler of galamsey since 2009 – Miracles Aboagye
results.content: The Director of Communications for the New Patriotic Party (NPP), Dennis Miracles Aboagye, has accused the National Democratic Congress (NDC) of enabling illegal mining, popularly known as galamsey, since 2009.

results.title: John Jinapor urges unity after NDC Yapei-Kusawgu constituency election
results.content: The Member of Parliament for Yapei-Kusawgu and Minister for Energy and Green Transition, Dr John Abdulai Jinapor, has called for unity and reconciliation within the National Democratic Congress (NDC) following the party’s constituency executive elections in Yapei-Kusawgu.

results.title: Galamsey has gotten out of hand – Sulemana Braimah
results.content: The Executive Director of the Media Foundation for West Africa (MFWA), Sulemana Braimah, says illegal mining, popularly known as galamsey, has spiralled beyond control, warning that the problem requires honesty and a united national response rather than political blame games.

results.title: NDC hasn’t shown the expected commitment to fight galamsey – Sulemana Braimah
results.content: Executive Director of the Media Foundation for West Africa (MFWA), Sulemana Braimah, has expressed disappointment in the Mahama administration’s handling of illegal mining, popularly known as galamsey, saying the government has not demonstrated the level of commitment expected of it.

results.title: ‘The state itself is complicit in galamsey fight’ – Bokpin
results.content: Economist and Professor of Finance at the University of Ghana Business School, Professor Godfred Bokpin, has accused the state of complicity in the fight against illegal mining, arguing that political interference and a lack of leadership have allowed the menace to escalate.

results.title: Take Akufo-Addo out of galamsey talk; it’s been 24 months since you took over – Miracles Aboagye
results.content: The Director of Communications for the Bawumia Campaign Team, Dennis Miracles Aboagye, has challenged the governing National Democratic Congress (NDC) to take responsibility for the fight against illegal mining, insisting that the party can no longer blame former President Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo for the worsening situation.

results.title: NDC gov’t has failed galamsey fight spectacularly – Miracles Aboagye
results.content: The Communications Director of the opposition New Patriotic Party (NPP), Dennis Miracles Aboagye, has accused the governing National Democratic Congress (NDC) of failing spectacularly in its efforts to tackle illegal mining, popularly known as galamsey.

results.title: African journalists adopt a continental action plan on responsible AI, decent work and media freedom
results.content: African journalist leaders have adopted an advocacy action plan to advance responsible artificial intelligence (AI), decent working conditions and quality journalism across the continent. The plan was agreed at the close of a two-day dialogue and capacity-building programme convened by the Federation of African Journalists (FAJ) in Addis Ababa on 24-25 October 2026.

results.title: COPEC projects petrol price to fall; diesel to go up on November 1 pricing window
results.content: The Chamber of Petroleum Consumers (COPEC) is predicting petrol prices to go down while diesel price go up at the pumps in the first pricing window starting, November 1, 2026. results.title: PMI, TIME Studios spotlight projects delivering climate solutions at scale
results.content: TIME Studios and the Project Management Institute (PMI), the world’s leading authority for project professionals, have announced Season 2 of The Solutionaries, a documentary series about the project success behind climate solutions that scale and what it takes to move from a solution that works once to one that works everywhere.
